status: E01 provenance for runtime brand files. v1.4 (2026-11-23): the home-screen icon is the kit's iPhone icon, iOS/apple-touch-icon-180.png, in place of PWA/apple-touch-icon.png, whose see-through corners an iPhone paints black
chain: Logo/icon sources are members of the pinned archive design/brand/archives (sha256 e7e93dde728048cb03ba78a1f761cc221af184bfda3bdd4234f7fd3df61f3638), checked in src/test/brandAssets.test.js. Font sources are vendored from the npm tarballs whose sha512 integrity is recorded per entry; the tarball check was done at import (2026-11-15) and is not re-run in CI.
excluded_from_runtime: Everything else in the 150-file pack stays design source only. Not used in this web app: PWA/apple-touch-icon.png (its see-through corners are painted black by an iPhone; iOS/apple-touch-icon-180.png is used instead, E01-E02 design section 5a); iOS AppIcon-1024 and Android adaptive layers (no native app; the PWA maskable icon covers Android launchers), print/PDF/letterhead files (E12), social covers (website, E12). The Freepik treasure map is not in public/ and not in a normal build; the build adds it only once release gate freepik-treasure-map-3570506 is cleared (design/brand/RELEASE_GATES.json; V1-F).
